definitions.explanation: Relating to the earliest period of human or natural history; in an original or undeveloped state.

examples.japanese: {原始|げんし}{時代|じだい}の{人|ひと}は{洞窟|どうくつ}に{住|す}んでいた。
この{島|しま}には{原始|げんし}の{森|もり}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Primeval forests remain on this island.

examples.japanese: {原始|げんし}的な{生活|せいかつ}に{戻|もど}ることは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to return to a primitive lifestyle.

notes:
{原始|げんし} refers to something primitive, primeval, or in its original state. It often describes prehistoric times or undeveloped conditions.

Common compounds:
- {原始|げんし}{時代|じだい} (primitive era, prehistoric times)
- {原始|げんし}{人|じん} (primitive man)
- {原始的|げんしてき} (primitive, in a primitive manner)
- {原始|げんし}{林|りん} (primeval forest)

Note: Can be read as げんし or げんじ, with げんし being more common.

Homophone: {原子|げんし} (atom) - different kanji, different meaning
